checks.why: a decorator the project declares is a dependency of everything it wraps: `@exporter("csv") def export_csv` means export_csv IS what exporter returned, so a test that drives the handler must run when the decorator changes — and nothing but the @ line says so, since the decorator has no call site and the table is read by a key
the inner function the factory returns is reached the same way, one hop further out: it is what actually wraps the handler
the hop is named for what it is. The decoration carries a simple NAME, so the declaration it denotes is matched by that name and not resolved, and the answer must not sell that as a resolved call
avoid: how sure each route is: 3 sound
